title: feat(lint): form layout, visibility and page-sort advisories carry a localized user sentence
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #32840

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单布局、可见性条件和页面排序这几类保存提示（advisory）现在也有给最终用户看的一句话，11 种平台语言都有：表单字段不存在、表单分区引用的字段分组不存在、visibleWhen 规则用错了根（`data.` / `record.`）、页面按外部对象并不存储的列排序，共 4 条规则 id；规则 id、`message`、`hint` 一字不变。
- 为什么改：按 #32835 / #32655 已落地的做法（裁决 6819749037 选 C），中文 Studio 里保存视图或页面时看到的仍是英文提醒；现在由出提醒的规则自己按用户语言出文案。卡片表里列的页面、导航、翻译类提示（实测 11 条）保存时根本不会返回（这些规则在发布门只随流程写入运行，而流程写入的快照里没有页面、应用或翻译），所以没有用户文案，原因写在验收说明里。
- 风险与回滚：只新增文案和发现对象上的一个可选字段；保存接口现在还不填 `userMessage`（那是 #32656），所以所有返回内容不变。`@objectstack/lint` 按 patch 发版。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.user-text.ts`（按 `root` 分两种写法、按视图/页面换名词）、`packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.ts`（字段分组提示的参数在调用处补上，共享 helper 不动）、`packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.pages-forms.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.pages-forms.test.ts`，应见 26 个测试全绿，其中三条是从发布门（两次视图写入、一次页面写入）拿到的提示渲染成能被 `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` 解析的 `userMessage`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Layer 1 of #32654 for the page, form, navigation and translation advisories, in the pattern #32655 landed (`validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`, `finding-user-text.test.ts`), under ruling record 6819749037 (option C).

**Re-measured first.** The card's table (9 ids in 8 files, a static-scan upper bound) was checked on `origin/main` `5b2ec820`: each advisory was planted in a whole stack, confirmed by calling its rule, and then every item of that stack was written through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` (types `object`, `view`, `page`, `app`, `flow` as the stack held them) with the snapshot context the door carries.

| Rule file | Advisory ids the rule emits | Reach the door (write) |
|---|---|---|
| `validate-form-layout.ts` | `form-field-unknown`, `form-section-group-unknown` (card: 1) | both (view) |
| `validate-visibility-predicates.ts` | `visibility-root-mislayered` | yes (view, page) |
| `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` | `page-field-unprovisioned`, `page-field-unknown` (its `skipped` grade), `page-section-group-unknown` (card: 1) | `page-field-unprovisioned` only at the page-sort site in `validate-sortable-fields.ts` (page); none at this rule's own sites |
| `validate-react-page-props.ts` | `react-page-source-unparseable`, `react-prop-deprecated`, `react-prop-typo`, `react-chart-aggregate-invalid` (its warning arm), `react-chart-field-unprovisioned` (card: 2) | none |
| `validate-nav-access.ts` | `nav-object-ungranted` | none |
| `validate-nav-target-refs.ts` | `nav-target-unresolved` | none |
| `validate-translation-references.ts` | `translation-option-key-unknown` | none |
| `validate-translatable-sections.ts` | `translation-section-name-missing` | none |

So 4 ids reach the door and get a sentence; the seat agreed to cover those and name the rest (see Acceptance notes).

**`packages/lint`.**

- Three catalogs, new, beside the rules that own the ids, each in all 11 `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` and in the console's terms from `ui/packages/i18n` (view, page, form, section, field, field group, object, external object, sort, the `visibleWhen` rule as the record form names it):
  - `validate-form-layout.user-text.ts`: `form-field-unknown` (`view`, `object`, `field`) and `form-section-group-unknown` (`view`, `object`, `group`).
  - `validate-visibility-predicates.user-text.ts`: `visibility-root-mislayered` (`surface`, `name`, `root`). One arm per `root`: `data` on a runtime view or page (write `record.`), `record` on a metadata-editing form (write `data.`), as the rule's message does; `surface` picks the noun (view or page).
  - `validate-page-field-bindings.user-text.ts`: `page-field-unprovisioned` (`page`, `object`, `field`), addressed to the page whose sort is ignored.
- Push sites:
  - `validate-form-layout.ts` sets `userTextParams` at the section-field site, and adds them to `checkSectionGroupRefs`' findings at its call site (keyed by each finding's `path`, which is its reference's). The shared helper in `object-field-groups.ts` is untouched: its other host emits `page-section-group-unknown`, which the door never returns.
  - `validate-visibility-predicates.ts`: `checkElement` takes the element's owner (`{ surface, name }`, passed by its three callers) and sets the params at the mislayered-root site only.
  - `validate-sortable-fields.ts`: `checkPageSortDeclaration` takes the page name (passed by all five page-sort callers) and sets the params at its `page-field-unprovisioned` site.
  - Each finding interface gains `userTextParams?`. Rule ids, `message` and `hint` are unchanged. No registry adapter drops the field (`validateFormLayout`, `validateVisibilityPredicates` and the reference-integrity suite pass findings through), so `authoring-rules.ts` is untouched.
- `finding-user-text.ts`: `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` merges the three catalogs via `mergeUserTextCatalogs`.
- No new export: the catalogs stay internal, as `SECURITY_POSTURE_USER_TEXT` is.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/32840-advisory-user-text.md`, `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. Precedent followed: #32837 (PR #33118), the sibling sub-card, declared `none` and `patch` for the same lint-only change, reading #32790 (the #32655 PR): its `added` came only from the `@objectstack/spec` key `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema.userMessage`, and it shipped the lint half as `patch`. This PR moves no spec key and no accepted value.

**Not in this PR.** The save door composing `userMessage` (#32656) and the console rendering it (#32657). Until #32656 lands, every save and publish response is byte-identical.

## Tests

Counts from the merged head `40ff8f91` (branch tip `d2634c67` on `main` `5b2ec820`, then `main` `dd4ce50b` merged through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` once #33140 landed). The merge conflicted in two files only, both resolved by keeping both sides: `finding-user-text.ts` (the catalog import and merge lists now carry #33140's four and this PR's three) and `validate-sortable-fields.ts` (one `userTextParams` field on `SortableFieldFinding`, its docblock now naming both the list-view and the page-sort sites; the duplicate type import dropped). #33140's own pin that asserted the page-sort `page-field-unprovisioned` warning carries no params is replaced by a pointer to this PR's pin, and its catalog note in `validate-sortable-fields.user-text.ts` now names the catalog that site feeds. No generated artifact left to regenerate; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0 after a full `pnpm turbo run build` (120/120 tasks).

- `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.pages-forms.test.ts` (new, 26 tests):
  - exact coverage: each of the three catalogs holds exactly its door-reaching ids, each in exactly the 11 platform locales; all are the entries `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` serves; the four ids are pinned by value;
  - the 11 ids the door never returns have no catalog entry;
  - every push site rendered from the rule's real findings (13 cases: the form field site from a simple form and from a Studio form item's `config`; the section-group site from both the `sections` and the legacy `groups` bucket; the mislayered root from a view section, a view field, a page component and a metadata-editing form; the page-sort site from all five callers: `interfaceConfig`, `record`, a block's `sort`, a block's `dataSource` and a related list's `parentDataSource`): severity `warning`, the exact params, every locale truthy, no `undefined` or template residue, every interpolated name present, and no English stand-in in any non-English locale;
  - the two `root` arms and the view and page nouns render apart in every locale;
  - zh-Hans and en spot checks on the form sentence;
  - no params where the finding is not door advice: the page-field-bindings rule's own sites, the two navigation advisories, a gating visibility syntax error;
  - from the runtime gate to the wire field: two `view` writes (the section-group advisory, whose params come from the call-site mapping, and the unknown field) and one `page` write (the unstored sort and the mislayered root) come out of `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` with their params, and the rendered `userMessage` (de-DE, ja-JP, zh-CN, fr-FR requests) parses under `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` beside the unchanged rule id and message.
- The four user-text pin files together (security, dashboards, data-model, pages-forms): Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 172 passed (172), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 205 passed (205), Tests 8762 passed (8762), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Consumer reading (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, which runs the gate on every save; after the full build): Test Files 337 passed, 7 skipped (344); Tests 22799 passed, 36 skipped (22835); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

<details><summary>Ablations (committed first, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

| # | Mutation | Observed |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `validate-form-layout.ts`: the call-site mapping sets `group: ''` instead of the reference's key | 3 failed, 23 passed (both section-group render cases and the view-write gate case) |
| 2 | `validate-sortable-fields.ts`: drop `userTextParams` at the page-sort site | 6 failed, 20 passed (the five page-sort render cases and the page-write gate case) |

Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed) and each restore read `blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD is empty`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Eleven advisory ids of the card's rule files stay on the English fallback, by measurement (parent #32835's Done-when alternative).** `react-page-source-unparseable`, `react-prop-deprecated`, `react-prop-typo`, `react-chart-aggregate-invalid`, `react-chart-field-unprovisioned`, `nav-object-ungranted`, `nav-target-unresolved`, `page-field-unknown` (`skipped` grade), `page-section-group-unknown`, `translation-option-key-unknown` and `translation-section-name-missing`, plus `page-field-unprovisioned` at `validate-page-field-bindings.ts`'s own sites. Their rules are reference-integrity members on the frozen `flow` default (`reference-integrity-suite.ts`, no `runtimeTypes`), so the door runs them only on a flow write, and a flow write's snapshot carries no pages, apps or translations (`RuntimeStackContext` holds objects, permissions, books, datasets, flows). `translation-section-name-missing` on an object's own sections is context on both sides of the differential and cancels. A sentence the door can never render would be declared but not delivered. A pin asserts each of them has no catalog entry.
- **The card's table counts differ.** `validate-react-page-props.ts` emits 5 advisory ids, not 2 (`react-prop-typo` is a literal, not a constant, and two chart ids warn on one arm); `validate-form-layout.ts` emits 2, not 1 (`form-section-group-unknown` is pushed through the shared helper); `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` emits 3, not 1. None of the extra ids of the react and bindings rules reaches the door either.
- **`page-field-unprovisioned`'s catalog lives with its owner.** The constant and its own push sites are `validate-page-field-bindings.ts`'s, so the catalog is `validate-page-field-bindings.user-text.ts`, and its sentence speaks of a sort: the page-sort site in `validate-sortable-fields.ts` is the only one that carries params. #32838 (PR #33140) left this id to this card by name.
- **Agent-written non-English sentences, for the native-review round.** All non-English sentences in the three new catalogs are agent-written: 10 locales (`zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`) × 4 entries, 5 sentences per locale counting the two `root` arms (`form-field-unknown`, `form-section-group-unknown`, `visibility-root-mislayered` ×2, `page-field-unprovisioned`), each with the view or page noun. Points worth a native reader's eye: `zh-Hant` writes "區段" for section, where the console's own string reads "分割槽" (a conversion of the Simplified "分区" that means partition); `ko` uses the console's "보기" for view; `ar` uses "العرض" for view; Korean particles are written in the dual form (`이(가)`, `은(는)`) because the name is interpolated; the external-object sort sentence follows the wording of the landed `sort-field-unprovisioned` and `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` sentences; `visibleWhen`, `data.` and `record.` stay untranslated, as the console's own `visibleWhen` refusal keeps the key.
- **API names, not labels**, as the security catalog does (its N3, accepted): the rule is a pure function of the stack with no label lookup in the request's language.
- **New test file, not `finding-user-text.test.ts`.** The pins sit in `finding-user-text.pages-forms.test.ts`, as #32837's sit in `finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts`, so parallel sibling cards do not collide; the shape is the same.
- Ruling grep over the surface (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): `validate-visibility-predicates.ts` 27 (the parse-only, unknown-function and `has()` rulings, all on the gating ids), `validate-sortable-fields.ts` 3 (type-list notes), `validate-form-layout.ts` 1 (the colSpan note), `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` 1 (ruling B on a related list's object), `finding-user-text.ts` 2 (ruling record 6819749037 and the one-locale-list rule); none constrains a user sentence or the push-site params.
